_meta.about: Texts of the Diskbox dashboard tile (the array, parity, pools and unassigned disks with usage, temperature and SMART health), its settings page and the Diskbox Balance page (moves whole titles between array disks, empties or removes disks). A 'title' is one movie or season: its download folder with the hardlinked files in the media library. The Discord messages and the technical run log are not here. Product and Unraid names (Diskbox, Unraid, Main, Shares, New Config, Mover, SMART, Pre-fail, Old age, ZFS, XFS) follow Unraid's own translation or stay as they are.

set.help_tile.text: Diskbox replaces the Disk Viewer tile. The array is shown as one card with a parity row underneath: green when the array is protected, amber while a parity check or rebuild runs, red when there is no protection, a data disk is emulated, or a disk has failed. The Needs attention list collects disks that are too full, too hot, show SMART warnings or are in a bad state.
set.help_tile.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the settings page. "Disk Viewer" is the name of Unraid's own tile; "Needs attention" names the list on the tile.

set.help_smart.text: Temperature limits for SSDs and NVMe devices are taken from Unraid's own display settings (Settings, Display Settings). SMART data is collected every 20 minutes with smartctl; disks that are spun down are skipped, so Diskbox never wakes a sleeping disk. Utilization and temperature colours use the values above, or Unraid's own when a field is empty.
set.help_smart.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the settings page. Settings, Display Settings is Unraid's menu: use Unraid's own words. May contain simple HTML tags: keep them.

set.help_discord.text: Discord alerts: Unraid checks every minute and posts to the webhook only when something changes: a problem appears, gets worse, or is over. A temperature alert needs three minutes in a row and an all-clear only after the disk has cooled two degrees; red alerts can repeat after the chosen number of hours. A SMART warning can be acknowledged with the button next to it on the dashboard tile; it then counts again only when it gets worse (the attribute's raw value rises). A failed health check cannot be acknowledged. SMART alerts name each attribute, say whether it is Pre-fail or Old age, and show its raw value, its previous value, and the value, worst and threshold. The buttons use the saved settings, so press Apply first. Create a webhook in Discord under channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks.
set.help_discord.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the settings page. Pre-fail and Old age are SMART terms: keep them as smartctl shows them.

bal.intro.text: Whole titles (a downloads folder together with its hardlinked media files) are moved between the array disks, and the hardlinks are kept. Nothing moves until you press Move. The paths in /mnt/user do not change, so qBittorrent, Sonarr, Radarr and Jellyfin keep working.

rm.s3.text: Make a plan in the Setup above: the plan (below) moves everything in the folders of the Setup to the other disks, then press Move. What it does not watch (for example appdata) is listed under the plan; move it yourself.

rm.s4.text: Lists every file still on the disks, hidden ones too (empty folders do not count). Clearing is possible only when nothing is left.

rm.h5.note: band title of step 5 (upper case on screen).

rm.s5.text: Each disk is unmounted and filled with zeros through parity (side by side), so parity stays valid without it: about 7 hours per TB. This erases everything on the disk. If the server stops meanwhile, Unraid shows the disk as Unmountable after the restart: do not format it, start the clearing again here.
rm.s5.note: lead line of step 5: a strong warning. Unmountable is Unraid's word. May contain simple HTML tags: keep them.

rm.h6.text: Take them out of the array

bal.foot.text: Each title is copied, checked (sizes and hardlinks), and only then removed from the old disk. If a check fails the copy is removed and the old files stay. Moving runs in the background at idle disk priority; it needs the array started and no parity check, rebuild or mover running. Closing this page does not stop it.

rm.checking.note: the Check the disks button while it runs.

rm.confirm.text:
Clear {d}?

Each disk is unmounted and every byte on it is overwritten with zeros (through parity, so parity stays valid). This cannot be undone.
rm.confirm.note: confirmation box before clearing. Keep the two line breaks (\n\n).

bal.plus_fs.note: small text: the file system's own space that stays on a disk to empty.

bal.chip_empty.note: red chip next to a disk that is to be emptied. Short.

bal.bars_tip.note: tooltip of the two bars of a disk in the plan.

bal.bars_tip_fs.text: , of which {s} is the file system's own space (metadata), not data
bal.bars_tip_fs.note: added to that tooltip on a disk to empty (starts with a comma).

bal.n_titles.note: count of titles (one movie or season each).

bal.n_media.note: count of folders that have only media files without a download.

bal.ticked.note: how many rows of a disk bar are ticked.

bal.to.note: where the ticked titles go, like "to DISK2 (12)".

bal.btn.go_n.note: main button under the plan with the count and size.

bal.waits.note: amber text next to the Move button when the move cannot start now ({why} like "a parity check or rebuild is running").

bal.pb_empty.note: grey text on the right of the Plan band in the Empty disks mode ({d} disk names).

bal.pb_spread.note: grey text on the right of the Plan band.

bal.pb_spread_to.note: grey text on the right of the Plan band with a target fill.

bal.selall_disk.text: Select / deselect all from this disk
bal.selall_disk.note: tooltip of the checkbox in a disk bar of the plan.

bal.from.note: title of a foldable bar of the plan: the titles that leave this disk.

bal.also_on.note: grey line under a media-only folder: the same folder exists on another disk.

bal.no_other.note: grey line under a media-only folder.

bal.vid_nodl.note: amber chip: a video file whose download (and torrent) is gone.

bal.more.note: button under a long list: shows the next rows.

bal.lib_tip.text: Files in the media folders of this disk that have no hardlink (a hardlink cannot cross disks, so they have none anywhere). Mostly pictures and .nfo that Radarr, Sonarr or Jellyfin wrote next to a film whose video and download are on another disk. A video file here has lost its download: nothing seeds it.
bal.lib_tip.note: tooltip of the "Library files without a hardlink" bar.

bal.lib_bar.note: title of a foldable bar under a disk in the plan.

bal.n_also.note: count: folders that exist on another disk too.

bal.n_only.note: count: folders only on this disk.

bal.nothing.text: Nothing to move: the disks are balanced or no title can be moved.
bal.nothing.note: message in the plan when there is nothing to move.

bal.stays.text: Stays on the disk to empty (outside the folders above, or left out; move or delete it yourself)
bal.stays.note: title of the bar that lists what would stay on a disk to empty.

bal.nothing_stays.text: Nothing else stays on the disk to empty once the ticked titles are moved
bal.nothing_stays.note: the same bar when nothing would stay.

bal.scanning.note: message next to Make a plan while the scan runs.

bal.saving.note: message next to Make a plan while the setup is saved.

bal.scanning_long.text: Scanning the disks, this can take a minute...
bal.scanning_long.note: message next to Make a plan when the scan starts.

bal.confirm.one:
Move {n} title, {s}, between disks?

The files are copied, checked and only then removed from the old disk. This can take hours. Pause or stop the torrents of these titles first if you can.
bal.confirm.other:
Move {n} titles, {s}, between disks?

The files are copied, checked and only then removed from the old disk. This can take hours. Pause or stop the torrents of these titles first if you can.
bal.confirm.note: confirmation box before the move. Keep the two line breaks (\n\n).

run.moving.note: state of the move in Activity (bold).

run.finished.note: state of the move after it ended.

run.stopped.note: state of the move after it was stopped.

run.error.note: state of the move after an error.

run.line.note: progress line of the move in Activity.

run.aband.note: grey text on the right of the Activity band during a move.

run.of_titles.note: after the state on the Activity band when the move ended.

it.wait.note: state of a title in the move list: not started yet. Short.

it.run.note: state of a title in the move list: being copied now. Short.

it.ok.note: state of a title in the move list: moved. Short.

it.skip.note: state of a title in the move list: left out (the reason follows). Short.

it.fail.note: state of a title in the move list: failed, in capitals on purpose (the reason follows). Short.

run.more_waiting.note: foldable bar of the titles still waiting.

run.not_moved.note: foldable bar of the titles that were not moved (after a stop).

run.n_skipped.note: foldable bar of the skipped titles.

run.n_done.note: foldable bar of the moved titles.

run.lines.note: count on the right of the log bar.

hist.title.note: foldable bar in Activity with the log of earlier moves.

hist.stopped.note: count of earlier moves that were stopped.

hist.last.note: date of the last move ({d} like 2026-10-14).

hist.none.note: text in Activity before the first move.

hist.idle.note: grey text on the right of the Activity band.

hist.idle_last.note: grey text on the right of the Activity band.

why.not_started.note: reason a plan or a move cannot start (after "Cannot start:" or "Moving waits:").

why.resync.text: a parity check or rebuild is running
why.resync.note: reason a move or the clearing cannot start now.

why.mover.note: reason a move cannot start now (Unraid's Mover).

skip.shares.note: why a title is left out of the plan (grey line under it).

skip.outside.text: has hardlinks outside the configured folders
skip.outside.note: why a title is left out of the plan.

skip.partial.note: why a title is left out of the plan.

skip.recent.note: why a title is left out of the plan.

plan.two_disks.text: At least two array data disks must be included.
plan.two_disks.note: error next to Make a plan.

plan.no_pair.text: No valid folder pair is configured.
plan.no_pair.note: error next to Make a plan.

plan.target_raised.text: The array as a whole is {avg}% full, so {req}% is not reachable; balancing to {avg}% instead.
plan.target_raised.note: amber note above the plan when the target fill is below the array average.

plan.balanced.note: note above the plan when there is nothing to move.

plan.tick_drain.text: Tick at least one disk to empty.
plan.tick_drain.note: error next to Make a plan.

plan.one_stays.text: At least one included disk must stay to receive the data.
plan.one_stays.note: error next to Make a plan.

run.died.note: red text in Activity when the background move died.

plan.died.text: The planner stopped unexpectedly (perhaps out of memory on a very full disk). Press Make a plan again.
plan.died.note: red text of the plan when its background worker died.

plan.starting.note: status of the plan right after Plan was pressed.

err.no_space.text: {d} does not have enough free space for the selected titles.
err.no_space.note: error of Start on the Balance page.

err.bad_line.text: Invalid folder line: {line} (use paths relative to the disk root, for example data/downloads/FILM = data/media/film)
err.bad_line.note: error next to Make a plan. Keep the example path as it is.

err.no_folder.text: Enter at least one downloads folder.

err.target.text: The target fill must be between 5 and 95 percent.

err.cannot_plan.note: error next to Make a plan ({why} a reason like "the array is not started").

err.cannot_start.note: error next to Move ({why} a reason).

why.disk_not_ok.note: reason the clearing cannot start ({s} is Unraid's disk status code).

rm.err.choose.text: Choose Remove disks in the Setup and tick the disks first.
rm.err.choose.note: error on the Balance page, Remove disks.

rm.err.move_check.text: A move is running; check when it has finished.
rm.err.move_check.note: error on the Balance page, Remove disks.

rm.err.step2.text: Step 2 first: a share can still write to the disks.
rm.err.step2.note: error on the Balance page, Remove disks.

rm.err.step4.text: Step 4 first: check that the disks are empty.
rm.err.step4.note: error on the Balance page, Remove disks.

rm.err.clearing.note: error on the Balance page, Remove disks.

rm.err.nodev.text: The parity-protected device of {d} was not found.

rm.err.cleared.text: {d} is cleared already; it does not need a second clearing.
rm.err.cleared.note: error of step 5 when the disk was fully zeroed before.

rm.err.starting.text: The clearing of {d} is starting (unmount, stand-in image); wait until the log shows it running or failed.
rm.err.starting.note: error of step 5 after a second click right after the start.

rm.err.not_empty_now.text: {d} is not empty any more ({n} files). See step 4.
rm.err.not_empty_now.note: error of step 5; {n} number of files.

rm.err.type.note: error of step 5; {w} the disk names to type.

run.nothing.note: red text in Activity when a started move has no title.

run.gone.text: a file is gone from the source
run.gone.note: why a title was skipped during the move (after "skipped:").

run.exists.text: a file already exists on the target
run.exists.note: why a title was skipped during the move (after "skipped:").

run.changed.text: a file changed in the last 2 hours
run.changed.note: why a title was skipped during the move (after "skipped:").

run.links.text: the hardlinks changed since the scan
run.links.note: why a title was skipped during the move (after "skipped:").

run.space.note: why a title was skipped during the move.

run.verify.note: why a title failed: the copy of a file differs ({p} the file).

run.verify_src.text: {p} changed on the source during the copy (a new hardlink or a replaced file); the copy was removed, the source is untouched
run.verify_src.note: Balance error after a copy; {p} a file path.

run.rsync_fail.note: Balance error; {n} exit code, {e} the end of rsync's error output (not translated).

run.verify_link.text: verification failed: the hardlink was not kept ({p})

run.stopped_copy.note: state text of the title being copied when the move was stopped.

run.rm_fail.text: could not remove the source files
run.rm_fail.note: why a title failed after the copy.

run.rm_fail_t.text: could not remove the source files of {t}
run.rm_fail_t.note: red text in Activity: the move stopped ({t} the title).

rm.err.step2_shares.text: Step 2 first: {l} can still write to the disks to remove.
rm.err.step2_shares.note: error next to Make a plan in the Remove disks mode ({l} share names).

run.fatal_why.note: red text in Activity: the move stopped because Unraid became busy ({why} like "a parity check or rebuild is running").

run.stopped_msg.note: amber text in Activity after a stop.

bal.btn.stop_now.note: button while a move runs: stops at once; the title being copied is rolled back.

bal.stopping_after.note: the Stop after this title button after it was pressed.

bal.stop_now_confirm.text:
Stop now?

The title being copied is rolled back: its copy is removed from the target disk and the original stays where it is. The copying done on it so far is lost. Stop after this title keeps it instead.
bal.stop_now_confirm.note: confirmation box of Stop now. Keep the line breaks (\n\n).

plan.scanning.note: status of the plan while a disk is read.

plan.nofit.one: {n} title does not fit on the other disks and is not ticked.
plan.nofit.other: {n} titles do not fit on the other disks and are not ticked.

dc.bl_start_d.note: Balance Discord message: text; {s} the size.

dc.bl_stopped.note: Balance Discord message: title when the owner stopped it.

dc.bl_moved.note: Balance Discord message: line; {s} count, size and time (3/5 · 1.2 TB · 2 h).

dc.bl_sofar.note: Balance Discord message: line after an error; {s} count, size and time.

dc.bl_skipped.note: Balance Discord message: line; {n} skipped titles.

dc.bl_fill.note: Balance Discord message: field name: how full each disk is now.

save.f_n_fill_warn.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_n_fill_crit.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_warn_use.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_crit_use.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_hot_temp.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_max_temp.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_hot_ssd.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_max_ssd.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_n_remind.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).

save.f_wk_hour.note: field name inside the {name} of a Settings save error (a number out of range).
